price.description: Base-10 unsigned integer string in the quote asset's base units

rate.description: Base-10 unsigned integer rate. Omitted when base and quote asset are identical.

rate_scale.description: Number of decimal digits used to scale rate. Omitted when base and quote asset are identical.

expires.description: Expiry timestamp of the ExchangeRate entry. Omitted when base and quote asset are identical.

block_height.description: Resolved indexed height (echoes At-Block-Height when supplied)
